concerns.text: T022 implements a 'global' permutation test (shuffling labels once before the loop) which directly contradicts FR-004 and the Spec's explicit requirement to perform 1,000 permutations *within* the nested cross-validation loop. This is a semantic weakening of the statistical validation requirement.

T029b implements a 'per-feature permutation test' (shuffling columns 100 times) to generate p-values. This contradicts the Plan and Spec (FR-005) which mandate FDR correction on *permutation importance* scores derived from the global model, not per-feature null distributions. This introduces an unauthorized statistical procedure.

T032 describes calculating R-squared stability on 'observed heat-pain threshold labels' (continuous regression). FR-007 explicitly requires a sensitivity analysis on the *median-split threshold* for *exploratory group comparisons*. The task conflates the regression target with the group-comparison mechanism, failing to satisfy the specific acceptance criterion.

T022 and T023 hardcode 1,000 and 200 iterations respectively. The Spec Assumptions state that if the dataset is too large, 'the number of resamples will be reduced'. The tasks lack the logic to dynamically adjust these counts, risking a violation of SC-005 (6-hour limit) and the Spec's own fallback assumption.
